title: Fight plan
description: fights/<id>.json: one fight choreographed before it is covered. The question and the ending come first; phrases say who is ahead and why; exchanges are written operator first (who acts, the move and its target, the answer, the result) and carry what changes (weapons in hand, wounds, posture, side). Cards cover exchanges; `cine_fight.py check` holds the cards to the plan.

scene.description: Scene id in scenes.json where the fight starts.

source.description: Where the fight comes from: book, chapter and edition, or the user's notes.

question.description: What the audience waits to learn, not who wins: 'Can a man who cannot outfence him still take his revenge?'

ending.description: The final picture, written first; the phrases are planned back from it.

bpm.description: Tempo of the music under the fight, when cuts are timed to it.

goal.description: What the fighter wants from this fight, which can change at a turn (say so in the phrase's why).

style.description: How the fighter moves and fights, in visible terms: guard, footwork, tricks, how skilled.

side.description: Screen side from camera side A at the start.

right.description: Prop in the right hand at the start (a props.json name).

left.description: Prop in the left hand at the start.

carried.description: Props worn but not in hand (a sheathed dagger, a coin in a sleeve).

marks.description: Wounds, blood or dirt already visible at the start, each a short phrase copied verbatim into card text.

posture.description: standing, crouched, kneeling, down, grappling, or another word.

phrases.description: Runs of 2 to 6 exchanges between pauses. The pause between phrases is where the audience reads the score.

ahead.description: Fighter id who holds the upper hand by the end of the phrase, or 'even'.

margin.description: How far ahead: 1 edge, 2 clear, 3 the other is nearly beaten. Default 1.

why.description: The story decision of the phrase, in visible terms: what turns it.

pause.description: What happens in the breath after the phrase: a line, a look, a step back.

pause_secs.description: Screen time of the pause, longer when it holds dialogue; default 1.

n.description: Move number, counting up through the fight.

lead.description: The operator: fighter id who acts first in the exchange.

move.description: The operator's move with its weapon and target in body words: 'thrusts the rapier at his opponent's chest'.

with.description: The prop the operator uses (a props.json name); omit for bare hands. Must be in the operator's hand at that move.

answer.description: What the other fighter does in return: parry, dodge, riposte, takes the hit.

secs.description: Screen time of the exchange; default 1.5.

card.description: Id of the shot card that covers this exchange.

src.description: Where in the source it happens (section and paragraph or line). Absent means added for the screen.

changes.description: What is different after the exchange.

right.description: New prop in the right hand, or null when it is dropped.

carried.description: The whole list of worn props after the exchange.

mark.description: A new visible wound or stain, a short phrase every later card copies verbatim.

side.description: The fighters cross: shown on screen in this exchange.
